cases.prompt: Write xUnit tests for Calculator.Add with several cases.
expectations: Uses [Theory] with [InlineData] and [Fact] for single cases.
Uses the constructor for setup rather than a setup attribute.

cases.prompt: How do I share an expensive database fixture across tests in xUnit?
expectations: Uses IClassFixture<T> for one class or ICollectionFixture<T> with [CollectionDefinition] across classes.
Implements IDisposable or IAsyncLifetime for setup and teardown.
Notes that tests in one collection do not run in parallel.
